messages.subject: compareFit() - Error in `.rowNamesDF<-`(x, value = value) : invalid 'row.names' length
parts:
I ran a grouped model on gender. Afterwards, I ran compareFit function.
Whereas I received values for the nested model comparison, following statistics product the following error
Error in `.rowNamesDF<-`(x, value = value) : invalid 'row.names' length

Traceback shows that (probably all) values are available. Any ideas where this error stems from?

fit.mga <- sem(modell, data=data, estimator = "mlr", std.lv=TRUE, group = "gender")
compareFit(fit.mga, nested = TRUE, indices = TRUE, baseline.model = NULL)
